name: Belmont
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Belmont, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Belmont, CA: Santa at the Firehouse, a Winter Wonderland Workshop and the Belmont Police Santa Parade.
lede: Belmont's city holiday lineup is built around Santa, with a mailbox at Twin Pines, a workshop for ages 5 to 12, Santa at the firehouse and a police escorted Santa parade through the neighborhoods.
celebrates: Belmont Parks and Recreation runs most of the season. Kids mail letters to Santa at a mailbox at 30 Twin Pines Lane and get a personal reply, the Winter Wonderland Workshop at Twin Pines Lodge lets children ages 5 to 12 decorate cookies and design ornaments, and Santa at the Firehouse and Toy Drive at Fire Station 14 comes with photos, snow and crafts, plus a calmer Sensory Santa session with therapy dogs. The Belmont Police Department closes the month with its annual Santa Parade on Thursday, December 17.
lastyear: In 2025 the city's lineup followed the same pattern. Santa at the Firehouse and Toy Drive took place on December 11, 2025, from 5:30 to 7:30 pm, with a Sensory Santa session at 5 pm. The Belmont Police Santa Parade followed on December 18, 2025, from 5 to 8 pm, and the city calendar listed the corner of Chesterton Avenue and Hiller Street for it. The Winter Wonderland Workshop and the last day for Letters to Santa came earlier in the first week of December.
facts: Belmont's name is believed to come from the Italian bel monte, meaning beautiful mountain, and the city was incorporated in 1926. Ralston Hall, built by Bank of California founder William Ralston on the Notre Dame de Namur University campus, is a historic landmark. A building from the 1915 Panama Pacific International Exposition now stands on Belmont Avenue. The main road Alameda de las Pulgas takes its name from the Rancho de las Pulgas.
trains: Caltrain stops at Belmont station, so families can ride the Peninsula line to the city, and the Twin Pines Park area is a short trip from downtown Belmont. For a bigger train day, San Francisco has a cable car museum and a railway museum for streetcar fans, and San Carlos and San Mateo stations are one stop away on either side.

faq: How do I send a letter to Santa in Belmont?
Drop it in Santa's mailbox at 30 Twin Pines Lane or postmark it by Monday, December 7, 2026, to get a free personalized reply.
When is Santa at the Firehouse?
Thursday, December 10, 2026, from 5:30 to 7:30 pm at Fire Station 14, 911 Granada Street. It is free, and families are asked to bring a new, unwrapped toy.
Is there a calm Santa visit for kids who need it?
Yes. The Sensory Santa session runs from 5 to 5:30 pm that evening at the same fire station and needs online registration.
When is the Belmont Santa Parade?
Thursday, December 17, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm. The city says the route will be shared soon.
Does Belmont have a Caltrain station?
Yes, Belmont station is on the Caltrain line between San Francisco and San Jose.
